sources.title: irynakov86/mae-checkpoint · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Repository status The Python file contains the model and runnable example or training entry point. config.json records the generated architecture settings. training_args.json records the default experiment recipe. model.safetensors is a valid initialization checkpoint for smoke tests; it is not presented as a trained benchmark checkpoint.
